about.title: Same town for 30 years, same address for 20.
text: Morgan Roofing has been in business for over 30 years in Galveston, Texas, and over 20 years at the same location, 1311 42nd Street.

We have our own custom sheet metal shop onsite, where we fabricate our own flashing, gutters, down spouts and chimney caps. We work in Galvalume, aluminum, stainless steel or copper, depending on what the customer requires.
We offer free estimates, along with an aerial view of your roof, so we can give you an accurate price.
